title: Worksheets (Estimating Worksheets)
summary: Open, modify, and refresh estimating worksheets to price community packages, calculate markups, and preview sales pricing.

gaps.description: SQL Injection sweep: Parameterized database queries in worksheet pricing operations that previously used string interpolation (DbQuote).

title: Job Setup
summary: Set up and manage active job records, select community, plan, elevation, select custom options, and initialize estimating sheets.

title: Job Budgets
summary: Create and generate job-specific budgets based on approved contracts, refresh cost items, and lock finalized budget records.

gaps.description: Typography styling: Grid elements default to modern sans-serif fonts instead of legacy 'MS Sans Serif' or 'Tahoma' 11px (8.25pt) from VB6. Grid row heights adjusted to 18px to match VB6 density.

title: Purchase Orders (Issue POs)
summary: Generate, modify, cancel, and transmit purchase orders to vendors, set up variance PO categories, and issue variance work orders.

gaps.description: Auth flow discrepancy: Added singleton security option service and cookie-backed real ASP.NET Core auth to secure PO endpoints across browser tabs, preventing direct /main URL bypass.

title: Send Purchase Orders (Sending Wizard)
summary: Send new or resend purchase orders (and RFQs) to vendors: choose the task, narrow the selection by community, job, vendor, PO group and purchase order, then Finish marks the selected POs sent (POMaster.DeliveryDate) and opens the ones set to print in the web report viewer (owner decision D1). NOI runs as a PO send (D2); after an Assign TBD commit the wizard opens on an extra Assignment page (D4). Legacy vs web screens: Screenshots/SendPurchaseOrders/README.md.

gaps.description: Open for the owner, no code change pending: the Ready print line shows when at least one PO will open in the viewer (legacy shows it when PrintedPOs <> 0, FPOSendingWizard.frm:1283); RFQ Ready says printing is handled outside the web application (RFQ has no print path); the print set is not split by the job PM's email (SendPO_CCPrjMgr, frm:1572-1577) because transport is out of scope (D1). Email, fax, SMS and accounting transport are out of scope by D1.

title: PO Change Orders
summary: Create purchase order change orders to adjust quantities, unit prices, or vendors on already-issued POs.

title: Create a Quote
summary: Configure estimates and quotes for custom home buyers and commercial contract projects, and convert approved quotes to active job records.

title: Accounting Import Options
summary: Configure options for importing vendors and data from accounting systems, including exluded vendor types.

title: Sales System Integration
summary: Configure CRM/web application APIs (CRM Client ID, API Key, Environment, Upload Paths) to sync plan and option data.

title: Vendor Communications
summary: Configure SMTP or Office 365 mail server credentials, PO submission / cancellation templates, and default CC recipients.

title: User Permissions
summary: Define user groups, general module access permissions, specific task-level restrictions, and assign members to groups.

gaps.description: MultiSelectDualListControl reference-equality trap: Mutating the bound SelectedItems list in place does not trigger a re-render. Must rebind with a new List instance.

title: Accounting Integration
summary: Configure integration settings for ERP/accounting engines (Sage 300, Sage 100, QuickBooks, Simply Accounting, Sage Intacct).

title: BuildPro Integration
summary: Set up BuildPro integration credentials, environment settings, multi-family scheduling templates, and automatic PO publishing options.

title: Corporate Info
summary: Set up company name, address, contact numbers, email, builder type (Commercial/Homebuilder), password complexity rules, and list of divisions.

title: Custom Job Properties
summary: Define custom metadata categories, field names, and data types to track extra properties on Job records.

title: Estimating Options
summary: Configure estimating systems (Sage Estimating, CG Visions, etc.) and landing/incentive/takeoff phase/item codes.

title: Purchasing Options
summary: Set up purchasing business logic, budget posting options, zero-quantity takeoff handling, rate retrieval options, and alternate cost code usage rules.

title: Role Definitions
summary: Define default contact roles for Vendors, Customers, and Job templates to manage communication flows.

title: Sales Price Settings
summary: Configure settings for sales pricing sheets, markup/cost adjustments, tax inclusion rules, and locking rules for posted sheets.

title: Adding Division Information
summary: Add and manage multiple operating divisions, setting up unique addresses, databases, and general ledger links for each.

title: Division Replication Wizard
summary: Replicate standard cost items, communities, assembly libraries, and option settings from a master division to target divisions.

title: Creating Communities
summary: Define communities (projects), code labels, active status, lot inventory listings, and assign managers.

title: Community Phases Setup
summary: Configure development phases for communities to manage construction sequencing, budgeting, and PO release stages.

title: Project Managers
summary: Set up project managers and superintendents, assigning them contact details to track field responsibility on jobs.

title: Excel Export/Import Process
summary: Export community lot templates and import completed lot inventory Excel sheets back into HomeFront database.

title: Creating Variance Job Cost Categories
summary: Define variance cost categories and tax groups linked to accounting cost categories.

title: Purchase Order Indexes
summary: Define Purchase Order index codes to group PO categories, and map default vendors to each index for automated generation.

title: Item Groups and Phases
summary: Manage Phase groups and Phase definitions (cost centers) used to organize items and estimate budgets.

title: Item Database Setup
summary: Manage the global estimating Item database, including SKU codes, description fields, units of measure, default cost categories, and import items from Excel.

title: Model and Option Assemblies
summary: Define plan/model structures, add sellable options, build option libraries, and specify component lists (assemblies within assemblies).

gaps.description: Dialog sizing discrepancy: The Add Vendor Pricing / Assemblies picker dialog had a double scrollbar issue. Solved by increasing dialog size to 1200x675.

title: Managing Vendor Pricing
summary: Set up vendor contracts and pricing schedules, update vendor item rates, export/import pricelists via Excel, and maintain pricing parameters.

gaps.description: Tree node filtering gap: Rollover/special tree nodes in FVendorPriceList tree representing global/corporate scopes had empty keys. A bug in the C# lazy-loader was filtering out empty keys, hiding child communities. Fixed by preserving all distinct rows.

title: Price Links
summary: Map price link relationships between material base items and dependent options/assemblies to auto-recompute prices when material rates change.

title: Mass Change Wizard
summary: Globally swap items, update phases, adjust cost categories, or change vendor codes across multiple option assemblies in bulk.

title: Creating Option Attributes
summary: Configure attributes (size, color, layout modifications) and link them to options for detail tracking in sales worksheets.

title: Rooms
summary: Configure room names and attributes (e.g. Master Bedroom, Kitchen) to link options and assemblies to specific locations in a plan.

title: Dimension Categories
summary: Define dimension categories (e.g. width, length, depth, height) and link them to unit of measure types for plan scaling.

title: Model Dimensions
summary: Define dimensions for specific models or plans to compute automatic quantity takeoffs based on plan sizes.

title: Components
summary: Add assemblies as components (sub-assemblies) to main base model assemblies to build hierarchical option dependencies.
